cases.source: An incident operator may restore the service into the isolated recovery environment before the normal change review, but only if a signed known-good image is used and the audit log remains intact. The restore must not expose the recovery environment to customers. For incident I42 the image signature was verified, the audit log is intact, and the target is the isolated recovery environment.
cases.transformation: For incident I42, an incident operator may restore the service into the isolated recovery environment before the normal change review. The image signature was verified and the target is the isolated recovery environment.
cases.purpose: Communicate the I42 restore permission to a fresh operator without granting external action authority.

obligations.source_quote: only if a signed known-good image is used and the audit log remains intact

cases.source: The staging database must not be copied to removable media. The operator proposes copying the staging database to a removable drive. No exception applies.
cases.transformation: The staging database may be copied to removable media. The operator proposes copying it to a removable drive. No exception applies.
cases.purpose: Communicate the staging-media rule to the operator.

obligations.source_quote: The staging database must not be copied to removable media.

cases.source: The incident desk may page the on-call database engineer when replication lag stays above twenty seconds for five continuous minutes. Paging does not authorise restarting the replica.
cases.transformation: The incident desk must page the on-call database engineer when replication lag stays above twenty seconds for five continuous minutes. Paging does not authorise restarting the replica.
cases.purpose: Communicate the escalation permission without turning it into a duty.

obligations.source_quote: The incident desk may page the on-call database engineer when replication lag stays above twenty seconds for five continuous minutes.

cases.source: During a declared outage, operators may retrieve the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal for diagnostics. The exception does not apply during a routine maintenance window. Routine windows are not declared outages.
cases.transformation: During a declared outage, operators may retrieve the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal for diagnostics. The exception does not apply during an operational disruption. Operational disruptions include routine maintenance windows.
cases.purpose: Communicate the outage exception and its limit.

obligations.source_quote: The exception does not apply during a routine maintenance window.
obligations.description: The exception limit must not be broadened.

cases.source: The change review must be completed before the deployment begins. A deployment that begins before the review is complete is unauthorised.
cases.transformation: The deployment must begin before the change review is completed. A deployment that begins before the review is complete is authorised.

obligations.source_quote: The change review must be completed before the deployment begins.
obligations.description: The order of review and deployment must be preserved.

cases.source: The investigation note records a failed checksum. It offers one possible explanation and does not establish the cause. The note does not grant an operator permission to discard the replica.
cases.transformation: The investigation note records a failed checksum. The operator may discard the replica and does not need further approval.
cases.purpose: Communicate what the investigation note establishes.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not grant an operator permission to discard the replica.

cases.source: An operator may retrieve the backup credential only if the incident ticket is open and the audit log remains intact. The credential must stay in the temporary isolated terminal. The ticket is open and the audit log is intact.
cases.transformation: Provided that the incident ticket is open and the audit log is intact, the operator is allowed to retrieve the backup credential. The credential must remain in the temporary isolated terminal.
cases.purpose: Paraphrase the retrieval permission while preserving both conditions.

obligations.source_quote: only if the incident ticket is open and the audit log remains intact
obligations.description: Both conditions must survive the paraphrase.

cases.source: The release requires an accepted security review, an approved change ticket, and a named production owner. The security review is accepted. The change ticket is approved. The production owner is named.
cases.transformation: The production owner is named. The change ticket is approved. The security review is accepted. The release requires all three: an accepted security review, an approved change ticket, and a named production owner.
cases.purpose: Communicate the same three conditions in a different order.

obligations.source_quote: The release requires an accepted security review, an approved change ticket, and a named production owner.
obligations.description: All three conditions must be preserved.

cases.source: The incident desk may page the database engineer when replication lag stays above twenty seconds for five continuous minutes. The dashboard shows nine uninterrupted minutes above twenty seconds. The policy also discusses office access badges, which are irrelevant to paging.
cases.transformation: The incident desk may page the database engineer because the dashboard shows nine uninterrupted minutes of replication lag above twenty seconds.
cases.purpose: Omit irrelevant badge material while preserving the paging permission and its condition.

obligations.source_quote: The incident desk may page the database engineer when replication lag stays above twenty seconds for five continuous minutes.
obligations.description: The paging permission and threshold must be preserved.

cases.source: During an outage, operators may copy the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal for diagnostics. The credential must not be sent by email.
cases.transformation: During an outage, operators are allowed to duplicate the recovery key into a standalone diagnostic terminal. The key must not be emailed.
cases.purpose: Use harmless terminology changes while preserving the permission and prohibition.

obligations.source_quote: operators may copy the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal for diagnostics
obligations.description: The retrieval permission must be preserved.

obligations.source_quote: The credential must not be sent by email.
obligations.description: The email prohibition must be preserved.

cases.source: The vendor may retain its recovery copy only for fourteen days and only if the privacy review is complete. The vendor must delete the copy after fourteen days. The vendor may not share the copy with subcontractors.
cases.transformation: Subject to completion of the privacy review, the vendor may keep its recovery copy for no more than fourteen days, must delete it afterwards, and may not share it with subcontractors.
cases.purpose: Summarise the retention permission and obligations without losing the conditions.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor may retain its recovery copy only for fourteen days and only if the privacy review is complete.
obligations.description: The retention duration and privacy-review condition must survive.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor must delete the copy after fourteen days.

cases.source: The exception window closes at 17:00 UTC on 16 October 2026. Requests must be submitted before 17:00 UTC to use the exception.
cases.transformation: The exception window closes at 17:00 UTC on 16 October 2026. Requests must be submitted prior to 17:00 UTC to use the exception.

obligations.source_quote: Requests must be submitted before 17:00 UTC to use the exception.
obligations.description: The deadline direction must be preserved.
